Path: business objects, records and views | records-forms.form-view-gallery | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx` (its record effect never sets `setLoading(true)` on a `recordId` change; `DrawerForm.tsx:364` does, on objectui `origin/main` `f9c06ef`) and `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx` (the wizard row) ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: after a record swap, the wizard keeps drawing the previous record's values, and they stay editable while the new read is in flight. This was measured by the objectui#10712 dev's probe through `SchemaRenderer` and `object-form`: the input reads `One` on the wizard and `null` on the drawer and the default arm. A form that shows, and lets a user edit, the wrong record's data answers wrong ⇒ p2, the grade of objectui#10712.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T01:32Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), `WizardForm.tsx` and `DrawerForm.tsx` on objectui `origin/main`, and objectui#10712's triage comment `5839162848`.

**Not folded.** objectui#10712 is the run-guard closure card (a superseded read commits last). This card is a different mechanism: no loading state on a swap. objectui#10712 is also in flight, and a card in flight is never folded into.

**Serial constraints.** objectui#10712 (in flight, PR 1 of 2 landed) names `WizardForm.tsx` in its surface. objectui#10715 (graded this round) also touches `WizardForm.tsx`. No open PR holds the file.

**Execution note.** Give the wizard's record read the swap-loading shape its siblings have. Add the wizard row to `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx`: `r1` lands, then a re-render to `r2` with the read held ⇒ no editable `r1` value is drawn. The drawer row is the control.

Dedupe re-check: every open objectui issue (162), plus the 1000 most recently updated closed issues and PRs, grepped locally for `recordSwapLoading` and for `WizardForm` near loading or swap ⇒ objectui#10712 (in flight, a different mechanism), PRs objectui#10723, objectui#10704 and objectui#10225, and a seat post. No duplicate.

Claim: PM loop round 11 — `domain:ui` execution seat 5

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default judgement tier; no path-derived mandate for these objectui paths).
Clause-②: no
Thread-read: 5851651489
Serial constraints cleared: the open-PR file lists were re-read in this act at objectui `origin/main` `5c61e5241`: 7 open PRs, and none touches `WizardForm.tsx` or `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx`. The triage names two cards on `WizardForm.tsx`:
- objectui#10712 is this seat's. Its PR 1 (PR objectui#10723) has landed, and its PR 2 carries `LineItemsPanel.tsx` and `useRecordQuery.ts` only, so it does not touch `WizardForm.tsx`.
- objectui#10715 (queued, unclaimed) waits: this seat holds it until this card lands.

`check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED.

`Clause-②: no`: the wizard shows its loading state on a record swap, as its four siblings do. No schema, export or accept set moves.

### Scope

The triage (`5851651489`): 「Give the wizard's record read the swap-loading shape its siblings have. Add the wizard row to `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx`: `r1` lands, then a re-render to `r2` with the read held ⇒ no editable `r1` value is drawn. The drawer row is the control.」

⇒ `Fixes #10726`

## ✅ ACCEPT: objectui#10737 at `6d66f60`

`domain:ui` seat 5, `session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`, 2026-09-27T03:00Z. Checked against the diff and CI, not against the report's own account.

```
Implemented-by:  claude/issue-10726-wizard-swap-loading
Reviewed-by:     session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy
```

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| the shape | `WizardForm`'s record effect takes `TabbedForm`'s and `SplitForm`'s swap-loading shape line for line: a `loadedRecordIdRef`, a `setLoading(true)` before `findOne` when `recordId` differs from the last landed id, placed after the create / no-`recordId` / no-`dataSource` return, and the ref advanced only behind the `cancelled` check. `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` add `setIsDirty(false)`, and the wizard has no dirty state. This is the triage's 「the swap-loading shape its siblings have」, not a new mechanism |
| claim limits | the other five layouts are untouched. PR objectui#10723's `cancelled` guard and PR objectui#10704's failure slots are byte-identical, with the new lines beside them. No dependency list, prop, export or schema key moves |
| swap walks | swap and back while the read is in flight, a failed read and its re-run, a same-record re-run, edit ⇒ create ⇒ edit, and an `objectName` / `dataSource` change on the same id. Each reads as the sibling does, and `loading` ends on every current run. A create wizard never re-enters loading |
| step state (the PR's open question) | kept, recommendation A. While the new read is in flight the wizard draws only its spinner, and once it lands every step reads the new record's `formData`. So no step draws a previous-record value. `completedSteps` / `invalidSteps` carry over as progress state, as they did before |
| pin | the wizard row in `recordSwapLoading.test.tsx` is red on base `WizardForm.tsx` and green at the head, with the drawer row as control. A same-record re-run row fails under an unconditional `setLoading(true)`. The seven removed lines are comment rewording and the `SectionedFormType` union gaining `'wizard'`, and no sibling row's assertion moved |
| contract review | **PASS** at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on this head, record `5852142319` on the PR. The seat read the reviewer transcript: every turn was at tier |
| clause ② | `no` holds |
| semver | `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-form`. Every changeset sentence reads true, and the pending `6237-wizard-step-config-split.md` still does |
| governed | NOT GOVERNED (3 paths) |
| CI | 3 skipped, 39 success, 0 red of this PR's own. The one other failure, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`, is not a required check and is red on `main` `c3a26ccda` too: `filterContextTokensSweep-10666.test.tsx` mocks a path under `packages/plugin-map/node_modules`, which the pre-install check cannot resolve (objectui#10731 / objectui#10732, ungraded; no fix exists yet). This diff adds no `vi.mock` |
| closing keywords | the only closing reference in the body is `Fixes #10726` |

Left as they are, and named in the PR: the swap key is `recordId`-only on every sectioned layout, so an `objectName` change on the same id does not re-enter loading. That is the shape the triage binds, shared by all five.

`ready` and auto-merge (squash) go through the relay ops `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in this act.
